data.user_prompt: Which companies offer data warehouse consulting services for enterprises? Give me a shortlist.

sections.text:
A strong enterprise shortlist includes:

- **Accenture** — Large-scale data warehouse modernization, hybrid/multicloud architecture, migrations, data engineering, and governance for global enterprises.[3][9]
- **Deloitte** — Enterprise data architecture, cloud warehouse modernization, compliance, governance, and master data management.[3][9]
- **Capgemini** — End-to-end warehouse design, cloud migration, ETL/ELT, lakehouse implementation, and BI modernization.[3][8][9]
- **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** — Global warehouse design, legacy-system migration, real-time integration, governance, and performance tuning.[6][9]
- **Cognizant** — Data warehouse engineering, ETL modernization, cloud data platforms, governance, and analytics.[2][6]
- **Wipro** — Enterprise warehouse migration, data integration, ETL modernization, and analytics enablement.[2][6][9]
- **HCLTech** — Data warehouse modernization, cloud migration, integration, and data governance for large organizations.[6]
- **Slalom** — Business-focused cloud data platform implementations, modeling, governance, and BI enablement; often a good fit for consulting-led transformations.[6][9]
- **IBM** — Enterprise data and analytics consulting, including warehouse and broader data-platform services.[8]
- **Innowise** — Full-lifecycle warehouse design, implementation, integration, migration, and support.[1]

**Quick selection guide:**

- **Largest, complex global transformation:** Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, TCS
- **Cloud migration and modernization:** Cognizant, Wipro, HCLTech, Slalom
- **Platform-specific services:** Snowflake Professional Services, Databricks, and Informatica Professional Services.[9]
- **More specialized or potentially flexible delivery:** Innowise, ScienceSoft, or McKnight Consulting Group.[1][7]
